# GroupDocs.Conversion MCP Server

MCP server that exposes GroupDocs.Conversion for .NET — convert documents between PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, images, and 70+ formats, list supported conversions, and inspect document info via AI agents (Claude, Cursor, VS Code / GitHub Copilot, and other MCP-compatible clients).

## Install

- With dnx (.NET 10 SDK, no install step): `dnx GroupDocs.Conversion.Mcp@26.7.1 --yes`
- As a global dotnet tool: `dotnet tool install -g GroupDocs.Conversion.Mcp` then run `groupdocs-conversion-mcp`
- As a Docker container: `docker run --rm -i -v $(pwd)/documents:/data ghcr.io/groupdocs-conversion/conversion-net-mcp:latest`
- Native prerequisite for native (dnx / global tool) runs on Linux and macOS: install libgdiplus — `sudo apt-get install -y libgdiplus libfontconfig1 ttf-mscorefonts-installer` on Linux, `brew install mono-libgdiplus` on macOS. Not needed on Windows (GDI+ built in) or in Docker (bundled in the image).

## MCP tools

- Convert — convert a document to a different format (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, PNG, JPG, and 70+ more) and save to storage
- GetSupportedFormats — list every target format the source document can be converted to, with primary/secondary indicators
- GetDocumentInfo — return file type, page count, and basic properties (author, title, dates, password-protected) for a source document

## Supported formats

PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, PNG, JPG, TIFF, GIF, BMP, SVG, PSD, TXT, RTF, CSV, EPUB, MOBI, EML, MSG, MP3, MP4, AVI, and 50+ more document, image, ebook, email, and media formats.

## Environment variables

- GROUPDOCS_MCP_STORAGE_PATH — base folder for input + output (defaults to current working directory)
- GROUPDOCS_MCP_OUTPUT_PATH — optional, routes output files to a separate folder
- GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH — path to GroupDocs.Total.lic, omit for evaluation mode

## Licensing

The MCP server is MIT; the underlying GroupDocs.Conversion engine requires a license for production use. Evaluation mode (no license): converted output carries an evaluation watermark, tool responses include an evaluation-mode notice, and a single server process can open at most 15 documents before restart. Free 30-day temporary license: https://purchase.groupdocs.com/temporary-license/ — purchase: https://purchase.groupdocs.com/pricing/conversion/net

## Example prompts for AI agents

- "Convert report.docx to PDF"
- "What formats can I convert sample.pptx to?"
- "How many pages does contract.pdf have?"
- "Convert all .docx files in the /uploads folder to PDF"
